table.retrieve:
SELECT
	CustomerCategory = CC.Name,
	AliasName=A.AliasName,
	CustomerName=A.Name,
	Sales = SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN T.InvTotal + T.Discount ELSE 0 END),
	Discount=SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN T.Discount ELSE 0 END),
	GST=SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN T.GST ELSE 0 END),
	PosFee=SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN T.PosFee ELSE 0 END),
	AdvanceTaxAmt=SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN T.AdvanceTaxAmt ELSE 0 END),
	SReturns = SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=2 THEN T.InvTotal  + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt ELSE 0 END),
	CGS = SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN T.CGS ELSE - T.CGS END),
	NetSales = SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN (T.InvTotal + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt) ELSE - (T.InvTotal + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt) END),
	GP = SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN (T.InvTotal  + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt - T.CGS) ELSE - (T.InvTotal + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt - T.CGS) END),
	GPPerc = (SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN (T.InvTotal + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt - T.CGS) ELSE - (T.InvTotal + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt - T.CGS) END)  / CASE WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN (T.InvTotal + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt) ELSE - (T.InvTotal  + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt) END)=0 THEN 1 ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN T.Type=1 THEN (T.InvTotal  + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt) ELSE - (T.InvTotal  + T.Discount - T.Discount - T.GST - T.PosFee - T.AdvanceTaxAmt) END) END) * 100
FROM
	CustomerCategory CC,
	Accounts A,
	Customer C,
	(SELECT 
		Type = 1,
		S.CustCode,
		InvTotal = ISNULL(MAX(S.Invtotal), 0),
		CGS = ISNULL(SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.AvgPrice), 0),
		Discount=ISNULL(SUM(D.ItemFlatDisc * D.LooseQty) + 
			SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) +
			SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * S.DiscPerc * 0.01) + 
			MAX(S.FlatDisc), 0),
		GST = ISNULL(SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
			SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) + 
			SUM(D.LooseQty * (D.SalePrice - D.ItemFlatDisc) * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (S.InvGstPerc1 * 0.01)), 0),
		PosFee = ISNULL(MAX(S.FBRPosFee), 0),
		AdvanceTaxAmt = ISNULL(MAX(S.AdvanceTaxAmt), 0)
	FROM 
		SaleLedger S,
		SaleDetail D
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND S.SaleInvCode=D.SaleInvCode
	GROUP BY
		S.SaleInvCode, 
		S.CustCode
	UNION ALL
	SELECT 
		Type = 2,
		S.CustCode,
		InvTotal =  ISNULL(MAX(S.Invtotal), 0), 
		CGS = ISNULL(SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.AvgPrice), 0),
		Discount= ISNULL(SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice * (D.DiscPerc * 0.01)) + 
			SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * S.DiscPerc * 0.01) + 
			MAX(S.FlatDisc), 0),
		GST = ISNULL(SUM((D.LooseQty + D.BonusQty) * D.UnitSalesTax) + 
			SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * D.GSTPerc * 0.01) + 
			SUM(D.LooseQty * D.SRPrice * (1 - D.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (1 - S.DiscPerc * 0.01) * (S.InvGstPerc1 * 0.01)), 0),
		PosFee = ISNULL(MAX(S.FBRPosFee), 0),
		AdvanceTaxAmt = ISNULL(MAX(S.AdvanceTaxAmt), 0)
	FROM 
		SRLedger S,
		SRDetail D
	WHERE S.Date BETWEEN :adt_startdate AND :adt_enddate AND S.SRInvCode=D.SRInvCode
	GROUP BY
		S.SRInvCode, 
		S.CustCode) T
WHERE 
	A.AccCode = C.CustCode AND 
	C.CustCode = T.CustCode AND
	C.CustCatCode = CC.CustCatCode
GROUP BY
	CC.Name,
	A.AliasName,
	A.Name
